title: Bridge-cancellation form of transported adjunct normalization
statement: For fixed Operations, Compositors, OpenComparisons, and CanonicalBridge, the adjunct of the explicitly bridge-transported intrinsic gamma agrees with the prescribed properOpenLambda inverse after postcomposition with the canonical pullback bridge isomorphism.

source.place: Core gamma, adjunct, and canonical transport package

proof.text: Expand the bridge factors, apply the intrinsic SemilinearProperOpen.gamma_adjunct equation, and identify the resulting composite with properOpenLambda through the normalized cartesian, restriction, clopen, and compositor factors.

source.place: Core gamma, adjunct, and canonical transport package

lean.statement: theorem transportedGamma_adjunct_bridge (o : Operations l E) (c : Compositors l E o) (a : OpenComparisons l E o c) (b : CanonicalBridge l E o) {U V W Z : Scheme.{u}} (k : U ⟶ V) (r : U ⟶ W) (p : V ⟶ Z) (i : W ⟶ Z) [IsOpenImmersion k] [IsOpenImmersion i] [QuasiCompact k] [QuasiCompact i] [IsProper r] [IsProper p] (h : k ≫ p = r ≫ i) (M : System l E U) : (o.extension i).adj.homEquiv _ _ (((Operations.shriek l E o i).map ((b.push l E r).hom.app M) ≫ (b.shriek l E i).hom.app ((ProEtale.SemilinearProperOpen.R (scalarRings l E) (scalarTransitions l E) r).obj M) ≫ (ProEtale.SemilinearProperOpen.gamma (scalarRings l E) (scalarTransitions l E) k r p i h).app M ≫ (b.push l E p).inv.app ((ProEtale.SemilinearProperOpen.J (scalarRings l E) (scalarTransitions l E) k).obj M) ≫ (Operations.push l E o p).map ((b.shriek l E k).inv.app M))) ≫ (b.pull l E i).hom.app ((Operations.shriek l E o k ⋙ Operations.push l E o p).obj M) = (properOpenLambda l E o c a k r p i h).inv.app M ≫ (b.pull l E i).hom.app ((Operations.shriek l E o k ⋙ Operations.push l E o p).obj M)
